items.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He flew me out here from New York. I remember playing that three times... His name was in the mix. So they made sure that I got the call.

ctx.x: Then, in the discography, Hermeto Pascoal. I’m not sure we mentioned him yesterday. When we talk about Brazilian music, he’s one of those . . .
